title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
description:
Given two integer arrays `preorder` and `inorder` where `preorder` is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and `inorder` is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.

All node values in the tree are guaranteed to be **unique**, so the reconstructed binary tree is uniquely determined.
constraints: preorder and inorder consist of unique values.
Each value of inorder also appears in preorder.
preorder is guaranteed to be the preorder traversal of the tree.
inorder is guaranteed to be the inorder traversal of the tree.
hints: The first element of `preorder` is always the root of the entire tree. Finding that value in `inorder` partitions the remaining elements into the left and right subtrees.
Recursively apply the same partitioning using index bounds `[inLeft, inRight]` instead of copying array slices.
Precompute a hash map from each value in `inorder` to its index so every root lookup takes O(1) time instead of O(n), bringing the total complexity to O(n).

examples.explanation: Root is 3 (first in preorder). In inorder, [9] is left of 3 and [15, 20, 7] is right of 3, yielding tree [3,9,20,null,null,15,7].
A single-element traversal produces a single-node tree [-1].
Root is 1, left child is 2, and right child is 3.
